title: Interrogātīva Fundāmentālia
subtitle: Prōnōmen interrogātīvum τίς/τί (dēclīnātum) et adverbia interrogātīva commūnia (ποῦ, πότε, πῶς, διὰ τί).
objectives: Dēclīnāre prōnōmen interrogātīvum τίς (masc./fem.) et τί (neutrum) per omnēs cāsūs, utrōque numerō
Distinguere τίς interrogātīvum (accentū semper acūtō, numquam gravī) ā τις indēfīnītō (enclīticō, sēnsū “aliquis”)
Recitāre adverbia interrogātīva commūnia: ποῦ, ποῖ, πόθεν, πότε, πῶς, διὰ τί
Formāre quaestiōnēs simplicēs cum hīs verbīs interrogātīvīs

content.intro: Μελίτη λέγει· τίς εἶ; Ἀγάθων λέγει· Ἀγάθων εἰμί. Σὺ δὲ τίς εἶ; Notāvistī hoc iam ex fābulā prīmā. Nunc τίς/τί dēclīnātur plēnē, et alia verba interrogātīva (ποῦ, πόθεν...) sē adiungunt.
content.explanation:
Μελίτη λέγει· “Τίς εἶ;” Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Ἀγάθων εἰμί. Σὺ δὲ τίς εἶ;” Μελίτη λέγει· “Μελίτη εἰμί.” “Πόθεν ἥκεις;” “Ἐκ τῆς πόλεως. Καὶ σύ, ποῦ μένεις;” “Ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ τοῦ διδασκάλου. Τίνος ἐστὶ τὸ βιβλίον;” (Melitē dīcit: “Quis es?” Agathōn dīcit: “Agathōn sum. Tū vērō quis es?” Melitē dīcit: “Melitē sum.” “Unde venīs?” “Ex urbe. Et tū, ubi manēs?” “In domō magistrī. Cuius est liber?”)

Notāvistīne τίς, τίνος, πόθεν, ποῦ — quattuor verba interrogātīva dīversa? Τίς (masc./fem.) et τί (neutrum) significant “quis?/quae?/quod?” cum sōlum vōcālem, vel “quī? quālis?” cum adiectīvō (τίς ἀνήρ; “quī vir?”). Fōrma haec est PRŌNŌMEN interrogātīvum — nōn cōnfundenda cum prōnōmine indēfīnītō τις/τι (“aliquis, quīdam”), quod habet fōrmās scrīptūrā identicās sed est enclīticum (sine accentū proprio, ex Gradū I).

rules.heading: a) Τίς/Τί: Dēclīnātiō Plēna
rules.body:
CāsusMasc./Fem. sg.Neut. sg.Masc./Fem. pl.Neut. pl.
Nōm.τίςτίτίνεςτίνα
Gen.τίνοςτίνοςτίνωντίνων
Dat.τίνιτίνιτίσι(ν)τίσι(ν)
Acc.τίνατίτίναςτίνα

Nōtā (rēgula aurea neutrōrum, ex Gradū II priōre): nōm. = acc. neutrī, singulārī et plūrālī. Nōtā etiam thema commūne τίν- vīsibile in plūribus cāsibus — indicium formae dēclīnātiōnis tertiae quam mox vidēbis systēmatice.

rules.heading: b) Τίς Interrogātīvum vs. Τις Indēfīnītum
rules.body: Duo prōnōmina scrībuntur IDENTIDEM (τις/τι in fōrmā basicā) sed differunt ACCENTŪ: τίς (interrogātīvum, “quis?”) habet SEMPER accentum acūtum, quī numquam mūtātur in gravem, etiam ante aliud verbum sine pausā (exceptiō ūnica ad rēgulam gravis, ex Gradū I) — hoc ipsum accentus persistēns est signum vīsuāle rapidum quō interrogātīvum ā cēterīs verbīs distinguitur. τις (indēfīnītum, “aliquis, quīdam”) est enclīticum (sine accentū proprio, ex Gradū I), sequēns verbum praecēdēns: ἄνθρωπός τις “homō quīdam”.

rules.heading: c) Adverbia Interrogātīva
rules.body:
GraecēSēnsus
ποῦ;ubi? (locus statūrius)
ποῖ;quō? (mōtus versus)
πόθεν;unde? (orīgō)
πότε;quandō?
πῶς;quōmodo?
διὰ τί;cūr? (litt. “propter quid?”)

Nōtā trichotomiam ποῦ/ποῖ/πόθεν, exāctē parallēla trichotomiae ἐν/εἰς/ἐκ (lēctiō priōre): status/mōtus-versus/orīgō — patrōnus recurrēns per tōtam syntaxem Graecam locālem.

examples: τίς εἶ; — Quis es? (iam nōtum ex Gradū I)
τίνος ἐστὶ τὸ βιβλίον; — Cuius est liber? (genetīvus possessōris)
διὰ τί οὐ λέγεις; — Cūr nōn dīcis? (interrogātiō + negātiō)

commonMistakes.wrong: Cōnfundere τίς (interrogātīvum, accentū persistente) cum τις (indēfīnītum, enclīticum) propter fōrmam scrīptūrae identicam.
commonMistakes.right: Distinguere per accentum: τίς semper habet accentum acūtum vīsibilem; τις enclīticum caret accentū proprio.
commonMistakes.why: Discrīmen sēnsūs est fundāmentāle: “quis vēnit?” (τίς ἦλθεν;) vs. “aliquis vēnit” (ἦλθέ τις).

commonMistakes.wrong: Applicāre rēgulam normālem gravis (acūtus → gravis ante aliud verbum) ad τίς interrogātīvum.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī τίς interrogātīvum est exceptiō: accentus manet semper acūtus, numquam mūtātur in gravem.
commonMistakes.why: Haec exceptiō ipsa est ūtilis signum: sī vidēs τίς cum accentū acūtō persistente ante aliud verbum, scīs statim esse interrogātīvum.

commonMistakes.wrong: Nōn distinguere ποῦ/ποῖ/πόθεν, adhibendō ūnam prō omnibus tribus sēnsibus (status/mōtus/orīgō).
commonMistakes.right: Applicāre eandem logicam ac ἐν/εἰς/ἐκ: ποῦ=ubi (status), ποῖ=quō (mōtus), πόθεν=unde (orīgō).
commonMistakes.why: Trichotomia locālis recurrit systēmaticē per Graecum; recognōscere patrōnum semel adiuvat memoriam omnium trium sēriērum.

exercises.title: Τίς Εἶ;
exercises.instructions: Lege, deinde responde secundum sensum, non verbum singulum.
exercises.passage: Μελίτη λέγει· “Τίς εἶ;” Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Ἀγάθων εἰμί. Σὺ δὲ τίς εἶ;” Μελίτη λέγει· “Μελίτη εἰμί.” “Πόθεν ἥκεις;” “Ἐκ τῆς πόλεως. Καὶ σύ, ποῦ μένεις;” “Ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ τοῦ διδασκάλου. Τίνος ἐστὶ τὸ βιβλίον;”

options: cuius sit liber (τίνος ἐστὶ τὸ βιβλίον)

exercises.title: Quid Vērē Dīcitur? (Ex Sēnsū)
exercises.instructions: Relege sententiās suprā. Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit, ex sēnsū, nōn ex nōmine cāsūs.

items.statement: “Τίς εἶ;” prīmum rogat Melitē, nōn Ἀγάθων.
items.explanation: Μελίτη λέγει· “Τίς εἶ;” — Melitē incipit dialogum.

items.statement: Melitē respondet sē esse ex urbe (ἐκ τῆς πόλεως).
items.explanation: “Ἐκ τῆς πόλεως” refert ad orīginem Melitēs.

items.statement: Ἀγάθων manet in domō magistrī, nōn Melitē.
items.explanation: “Ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ τοῦ διδασκάλου” refert ad locum ubi Ἀγάθων manet.

items.statement: “Τίνος ἐστὶ τὸ βιβλίον;” rogat DE LOCŌ librī, nōn dē possessōre eius.
items.explanation: Falsum: τίνος (genetīvus) rogat “cuius?” — possessōrem, nōn locum.

items.prompt: Quae fōrma est genetīvus singulāris (masc./fem./neut.) prōnōminis τίς/τί?
items.explanation: Genetīvus singulāris, omne genere, est τίνος.

options: accentus: τίς semper acūtus persistēns, τις enclīticum sine accentū
items.explanation: Discrīmen est accentuāle: τίς retinet semper acūtum, τις est enclīticum.

items.prompt: Mūtāturne accentus τίς interrogātīvī in gravem ante aliud verbum?
items.explanation: Τίς interrogātīvum est exceptiō explicita ad rēgulam gravis.

items.prompt: Quae est fōrma accūsātīvī singulāris neutrī τί?
items.explanation: Nōm. = acc. in neutrō: τί (rēgula aurea neutrōrum).

exercises.title: Complē cum Fōrmā Rēctā
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā prōnōminis τίς/τί, secundum cāsum indicātum.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Τίς interrogātīvum et τις indēfīnītum scrībuntur identidem in fōrmā basicā, sed differunt accentū.
Genetīvus et datīvus singulārēs τίς/τί sunt identicī inter masc./fem./neut.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: τίνος (gen.), τίνι (dat.) servunt omnibus generibus in singulārī.

items.statement: Nōminātīvus et accūsātīvus τί (neutrum) sunt identicī, sīcut rēgula aurea neutrōrum praedicit.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: τί servit ambōbus cāsibus, sīcut omne nōmen/prōnōmen neutrum.

summary: Τίς/τί (interrogātīvum): nōm. τίς/τί, gen. τίνος, dat. τίνι, acc. τίνα/τί (sg.) — τίνες/τίνα, τίνων, τίσι(ν), τίνας/τίνα (pl.).
Τίς interrogātīvum retinet SEMPER accentum acūtum (exceptiō ad rēgulam gravis); τις indēfīnītum est enclīticum.
Adverbia interrogātīva: ποῦ (ubi), ποῖ (quō), πόθεν (unde), πότε (quandō), πῶς (quōmodo), διὰ τί (cūr).
